Order 
1 . This is a repeat (second) application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 26.7.2023 in connection with Crime No. 294/2023, registered at Police Station Seoni Malwa District Narmadapuram for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(i) and 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act.

sentences.text: She was a consenting party and her age is also disputed by the applicant.
It is submitted that she is more than 18-19 years of age.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the State as well as counsel for the objector have opposed the bail application.
It is submitted by them that prosecutrix in her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. has made allegation of rape against the applicant.
She has also stated that applicant was harassing her for last one year and on one occasion he took the prosecutrix along with him to his lonely house and committed rape on her.
Thereafter, he again committed the said act threatening her of making the videos viral.
In these circumstances, application may be dismissed.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5 .
Applicant is in jail since 26.7.2023.
Prosecutrix in 164 Cr.P.C statement stated that on 3 or more occasions applicant has taken her to his lonely house and committed rape on her.
She did not report first, second and third incident to any body.
Later on she has made complaint regarding the incident.
Police has not seized any photographs or videos to give strength to version of prosecutrix that she was under threat that videos may be made viral.
Age of prosecutrix that she is minor is also under dispute.
Prosecutrix has already been examined in the Court and now there is no chances that applicant will be able to influence her or any other witnesses in the case.
6 . Considering the long period of custody of applicant i.e. six months and the fact that there is no likelihood of completion of trial in future, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of R s . 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

8. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..
Certified copy as per rules.
